Callout.Name: Assault with a Glass
Callout.Message: Person cut in a bar, injury to the neck.
Callout.Patient: It is not as bad as it looks. Is it as bad as it looks?

Lines.Approach: Cut across the neck with a glass and the suspect has gone. Pressure on it and get him out of there.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
